verdict.rationale: Docs confirm skills are built with a `description` field and that skill creation explicitly asks 'when it should trigger' (docs-7, docs-13), and community commentary notes skills use progressive disclosure rather than stuffing all instructions into context, implying description-based auto-selection (comm-2). However, there is no detailed documentation of the matching/triggering algorithm itself, and usage instructions emphasize manual invocation via `/skills` or `$mention` (docs-20) alongside any automatic behavior, plus some community skepticism about reliability of skill activation compared to MCP tools (comm-1, comm-6). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the automatic trigger-matching mechanism, worked examples showing correct skill selected from context, and independent hands-on confirmation that triggering works reliably in practice.
